archimate:Principle.name: A&T-03 Active Life Cycle management
archimate:Principle.documentation: With active Life Cycle management we prevent overdue maintenance in the IV landscape so that continuity & security risks are mitigated, among other things. Without Life Cycle management, systems or parts thereof can become outdated and thus become vulnerable in terms of security. Without active Life Cycle management, a technological debt is also built up that, when it eventually has to be repaid, will require disproportionate effort or introduce continuity risks. Keeping systems and components up-to-date in accordance with established LCM policy mitigates these risks.
